name: Shunem
brief: Town in Issachar; home of the Shunammite woman
short: Shunem was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar (<ref="Josh. 19:18">Josh. 19:18</ref>), known for being the home of the Shunammite woman who hosted Elisha (<ref="2Ki. 4:8">2Ki. 4:8</ref>) and where the Philistines camped before battling Saul (<ref="1Sam. 28:4">1Sam. 28:4</ref>).
